description: Marseille - Casernes de pompiers is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Marseille. Liste des casernes de pompiers à Marseille: coordonnées, informations et points de géolocalisation. Plus d'informations: Bataillon de Marins-Pompiers de Marseille. Coverage: Ville de Marseille. The portal shows the English title as "Marseille - Fire stations" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Marseille. Its keywords include pompier, secours, marin-pompier, bataillon. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XY, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
